narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to humanize the medical staff at DRX Dermatology Clinic through a humorous behind-the-scenes interaction. By joking about staff members not following doctor's orders while simultaneously showing positive skin results (reduced pores), it builds relatability and promotes clinic services in a soft-sell approach.
